reason: I'd send the free 30 receipts to see the report, sure, it costs nothing. But paying $19 every month for something my staff and I might stop forwarding to after two weeks? No, I already see the receipts in the group and I cancel anything we don't use every week.
objection: After the free part we'll just go back to how we do it now, and I'll be paying for a bot nobody remembers to use.
would_change_my_mind: If the free report actually caught a duplicate payment or a wrong amount that cost me more than a few months of the fee, I'd pay for a month and see if it keeps finding things.
